name: Jong Song Hwa

attribution.legal_posture: Jong Song Hwa was CEO of Yanbian Silverstar and Volasys Silverstar; he was charged in the United States in 2024, and the charges are allegations. He is reported as a DPRK national. Current OFAC exact-ID component-table data adds only the bounded administrative-list verification and structured context stated here. The existing charging-stage posture is unchanged; the FBI page listed him as wanted when reviewed on 2026-08-12. OFAC designated Jong Song Hwa on 2018-09-13, and the Republic of Korea autonomously sanctioned him on 2023-04-24. Official sources identify him as CEO of Yanbian Silverstar. The sanctions are administrative actions; adjudication and conviction status remain unestablished.

organizations: Yanbian Silverstar Network Technology Co., Ltd.
